Package index

Render reports

Entry points that build the cached pep_all table and render the parameterized QC report templates (00_mhc_report all-in-one, or the focused 01-07 reports)

build_pep_all()
Build (and optionally cache) the unified pep_all table from raw search output
run_howmahico_report()
Render a HowMaHiCo QC report from the installed package templates
derive_filtered_annotation()
Derive a Condition-filtered copy of a sample annotation file
get_report_template()
Get the HowMaHiCo templates
get_pipeline_script()
Copy the guided analysis-pipeline script to the working directory

Annotation

Read, validate, display, and auto-generate sample annotation tables

read_annot()
Read, validate, and reformat a sample annotation table
print_annot()
Render an annotation table as an interactive HTML datatable
get_annot_fragpipe()
Auto-generate a skeleton annotation table from FragPipe psm.tsv files
get_annot_diann()
Auto-generate a skeleton annotation table from DIA-NN report.tsv files
get_annot_peaks()
Auto-generate a skeleton annotation table from a PEAKS export folder
get_annot_sampleid()
Enrich an annotation table with Sample_ID from a Bruker HyStar sample list

Report helpers

Shared settings the report templates derive from their params: the MHC length window and palette, and the Condition pairs to compare

mhc_length_window()
Peptide-length window of an MHC class
mhc_class_palette()
Two-colour fill palette of an MHC class
mhc_classes()
Names of the built-in MHC classes
condition_pairs()
All pairwise Condition comparisons
provider_line()
Provider sentence of a report header
pep_all_glossary()
Glossary of the pep_all columns

Data loaders

Software-specific loader families that converge on the unified pep_all schema

read_fragpipe()
Read one FragPipe psm.tsv or DIA-NN report.tsv file
read_fragpipe_batch()
Batch-read FragPipe psm.tsv files and merge them
parse_fragpipe()
Parse raw FragPipe PSM results into pep_all format
annotate_fragpipe()
Join parsed FragPipe results to the sample annotation table
read_diann()
Read one DIA-NN report.tsv file
read_diann_batch()
Batch-read DIA-NN report.tsv files and merge them
parse_diann()
Parse raw DIA-NN report results into pep_all format
annotate_diann()
Join parsed DIA-NN results to the sample annotation table
read_peaks()
Read one PEAKS peptide.csv export into long format
read_peaks_batch()
Batch-read PEAKS export folders and merge them into raw long format
parse_peaks()
Parse raw PEAKS results into pep_all format
annotate_peaks()
Join parsed PEAKS results to the sample annotation table

Custom (dictionary-driven) parsing

The software = "custom" path: ingest a tabular export from a tool with no built-in loader by editing a YAML dictionary instead of writing R code.

get_dictionary_template()
Copy the custom-parser dictionary template to the working directory
read_dictionary()
Read and validate a HowMaHiCo parser dictionary
read_custom_batch()
Batch-read a generic per-sample tabular export
parse_unified()
Parse a raw search-engine export into pep_all via a dictionary
annotate_unified()
Join a dictionary-parsed table to the sample annotation

Checks

Guard against clobbering existing output and summarise global ID composition

check_file_exists()
Check whether a single output file already exists
check_output_exists()
Check whether any of the report's standard output files already exist
check_ids_global()
Total ID counts split by protein/decoy/contaminant assignment

Counting & overlap analysis

Tabulate ID counts, charge/area summaries, sequence lists, and cross-condition overlaps

count_ids()
Count distinct peptides, sequences, and proteins
count_ids_condition_bylengthrange()
ID counts and proportions by Length_range and Condition
count_ids_by()
Wide table of peptide identifications by an arbitrary grouping
get_charge_group()
Classify charge states into +1/+2/>= +3 groups
get_proportion_charge()
Proportions of each charge group within a count table
get_mat_log2area()
Build a Log2Area matrix for clustering/heatmaps/correlation
summarise_area()
Per-peptide Area mean/sd/%CV summary by group
list_sequences()
List unique peptide sequences per group
count_intersect()
Count distinct elements shared between two conditions
count_merged()
Count distinct elements across the union of two conditions
count_samples_patients()
Combined per-Patient/Sample_type/Condition sample-and-patient count summary
select_unique()
Select distinct rows on a subset of columns
filter_unique()
Filter rows and drop to distinct/unused-level state

Plotting

QC plots covering ID size/charge distributions, overlaps, motifs, and correlation

plot_peplength_dens()
Peptide length distribution: boxplot + density histogram
plot_peplength_hist()
Peptide length histogram faceted by Condition
plot_pepmass()
Peptide mass distribution: boxplot + density histogram with apex annotation
plot_pepmz()
Peptide m/z distribution: boxplot + density histogram with apex annotation
plot_bp_count_length()
Stacked bar chart of total ID counts per Condition, split by length range
plot_count_mean_sd()
Mean ± SD barplot of ID counts per Condition, faceted by length range
plot_prop_length_condition()
Stacked bar chart of peptide proportions by Length_range and Condition
plot_charge_proportions()
Stacked bar chart of charge-state proportions by group
plot_overlap_intra_condition()
Overlap barplot for one ID level
plot_upset()
UpSet plot of overlap between groups for a given variable
plot_upset_batch()
Batch of UpSet plots across several variables
plot_pseudochromatogram()
Peptide ID pseudochromatogram: count vs RT, faceted by Condition
plot_pseudomobilogram()
Peptide ID pseudomobilogram: count vs 1/k0, faceted by Condition
plot_2d_distribution()
2D binned heatmap for any two continuous peptide properties
plot_violin_areacv()
Violin + boxplot of Area %CV by group
plot_qc_box()
Boxplot of Score or mass error per Condition and charge
plot_qc_violin()
Violin + overlaid boxplot of Score or mass error per Condition and charge
plot_corr()
Pearson correlation heatmap of log2(Area)
plot_ptm_heatmap()
Heatmap of PTM counts or proportions for length-filtered peptides
ggseqlogo_bylength()
Sequence motif logo for peptides of a given length
theme_rawr()
HowMaHiCo's shared ggplot theme
theme_howmahico()
HowMaHiCo's unified ggplot theme

Sample quality score

Per-sample immunopeptidomics quality score behind the 05_quality_score report: raw signals (length-window fidelity, canonical-length dominance, anchor-motif clarity, non-tryptic specificity, charge plausibility, depth, mass accuracy, cross-class contamination), the threshold model, and the weighted 0-100 composite.

score_sample_quality()
Score immunopeptidomics samples for overall quality
qc_metrics_by_sample()
Raw per-sample immunopeptidomics quality metrics
anchor_information_content()
Per-position anchor information content of equal-length peptides
score_curve()
Map a raw metric value to a 0-100 quality sub-score
quality_thresholds_default()
Default quality-score thresholds and weights
calibrate_thresholds_from_qc()
Derive QC-relative thresholds from tagged quality-control samples
plot_quality_heatmap()
Traffic-light heatmap of per-sample quality sub-scores
plot_quality_composite()
Per-sample composite quality-score bar chart
plot_cross_class_length()
Per-sample peptide-length histogram highlighting cross-class contamination

Advanced quantification & statistics

Build the quantitative matrix and compare peptide Area between Conditions (filtering, normalization, imputation, limma moderated t / Welch t, Fisher presence-absence, PERMANOVA) plus the plots of the 06_quant_stats report

build_quant_matrix()
Build a feature x unit log2(Area) matrix from pep_all
filter_quant()
Filter a quantitative matrix to testable features
normalize_quant()
Between-sample normalization of a log2 intensity matrix
impute_quant()
Left-censored imputation of missing quantitative values
test_differential()
Differential abundance between conditions
test_detection()
Presence/absence test between conditions (Fisher exact)
combine_quant_results()
Combine the quantitative and presence/absence tracks
summarise_significant()
Count significant features per contrast
permanova_condition()
Global permutation test of condition separation (PERMANOVA)
plot_completeness()
Data completeness of a quantitative matrix
plot_missing_heatmap()
Presence/absence map of a quantitative matrix
plot_intensity_dist()
Intensity distribution per unit (normalization diagnostic)
plot_dynamic_range()
Dynamic range (rank-abundance) per condition
plot_pca()
Principal component analysis of a quantitative matrix
plot_quant_heatmap()
Heatmap of a quantitative matrix, clustered or in annotation order
plot_volcano()
Volcano plot of a differential-abundance result
plot_ma()
MA plot of a differential-abundance result
plot_pvalue_hist()
P-value histogram (test calibration diagnostic)
plot_sig_summary()
Significant-feature counts per contrast

Physicochemical properties

Peptide-chemistry engine behind the 07_pepchem report: amino-acid composition, per-position residue frequency and per-peptide descriptors (GRAVY, pI, charge, …), summarised per sample and compared between Conditions.

peptide_properties()
Per-sequence physicochemical descriptors
pepchem_properties()
Descriptor columns of a property set
aa_composition()
Position-independent amino-acid composition
aa_position_frequency()
Per-position amino-acid frequency
pepchem_by_sample()
Per-sample peptide physicochemical descriptors
summarise_pepchem()
Summarise peptide descriptors within a group
aggregate_pepchem()
Aggregate per-sample descriptor summaries to Conditions
cliffs_delta()
Cliff's delta effect size
compare_pepchem()
Compare peptide descriptors between Conditions
compare_aa_frequency()
Compare amino-acid frequencies between Conditions
plot_aa_composition()
Amino-acid composition across groups
plot_aa_position_heatmap()
Per-position amino-acid frequency heatmap
plot_property_distribution()
Distribution of one peptide descriptor across Conditions
plot_property_sample_summary()
Per-Condition mean +/- sd of a descriptor across samples
plot_property_effectsize()
Effect sizes of the between-condition comparison

Protein-level analysis

Condenses the peptide table to source-protein level (the prot_all table behind the 08_prot_all report), including the protein-level values the search engine itself reported.

build_prot_all()
Condense pep_all to one row per protein and sample
summarise_prot_all()
Condense the protein table across samples
top_source_proteins()
Rank the most prolific source proteins
expand_mapped_proteins()
Expand peptides onto every protein they map to
prot_engine_columns()
Protein-level columns the search engine reported
diann_protein_columns()
Engine-reported protein-level column names
plot_proteins_per_sample()
Source proteins identified per sample
plot_peptides_per_protein()
Distribution of ligands per source protein
plot_top_proteins()
Ranked bar chart of the most prolific source proteins
plot_protein_detection()
How widely each source protein is detected
plot_ligand_vs_protein_quant()
Summed ligand intensity against the search engine's protein quantity

Modifications (PTMs)

Translate the engine-specific PTM tokens carried in pep_all$PTM – UniMod accessions from DIA-NN, monoisotopic delta masses from FragPipe and PEAKS – into readable modification names at plot time

ptm_reference()
Reference table of common peptide modifications
translate_ptm()
Translate PTM tokens into readable modification names

Export & I/O helpers

Write report outputs (plots, csvs, render parameters) to disk

ggsave_rawr()
Save a ggplot to a folder, skipping plots that were never built
ggprint_rawr()
Print a plot, skipping ones that were never built
write.csv_rawr()
Write a data frame to csv, named after the variable that was passed in
write_input_params()
Write a report's render parameters to csv
